verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Phoenix captures the underlying signals: latency analysis (docs-12, docs-38), token-usage breakdowns for spotting expensive calls (docs-46), and eval scores on traces and spans (docs-39, docs-42). Span data can also be queried and filtered through the SDK (docs-30), so custom dashboards would have to be built externally from that data. Nothing in the pack documents a custom dashboard or charting feature, and error-rate metrics are not evidenced. Missing for 10: a native custom dashboard builder, error-rate metric views, cost (dollar) metrics beyond token counts, aggregated time-series charts, independent corroboration.
